title: Can occupational therapy help if my child has issues with personal space?
metaTitle: Teaching Personal Space Respect with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how the expert occupational therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network assist children with autism in understanding and respecting the concept of personal space.
html: Of course! Understanding and respecting personal space is an essential part of social interaction. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our occupational therapists incorporate activities and strategies tailored towards teaching your child about the concept of personal space. Through role-plays, social stories, and other interactive activities, we help your child grasp this crucial social skill. It embodies our commitment to helping your child build meaningful relationships and interact more seamlessly with their surroundings.
